goal: Add a trimmed CASE01/CASE03 diagnostic runner that isolates production generation, repair, independent behavior probes, and audit from delivery side branches.
acceptance_criteria: The runner invokes only provider auto-select, the reviewed production facade, independent behavior probes, frozen evaluator scoring, and read-only failure audit.
ACFV, commercial readiness, Telegram, final promotion, packaging, and public delivery are never invoked and any observed side-branch marker is reported.
CASE01 reports static root, upload, clean/preview, and export behavior with actual issue, ProviderJob, delta, and acceptance linkage.
CASE03 stops honestly at semantic handoff when no candidate is materialized and classifies the blocker without fabricated post-build evidence.
Frozen benchmark hashes and tracked source remain unchanged during each live diagnostic run.

quality_metrics.measure: behavior-to-repair trace coverage and forbidden side-branch calls
quality_metrics.target: four CASE01 and five CASE03 diagnostic chains with unexpected_side_branch_called=false
quality_metrics.method: focused regression plus one fresh live CASE01/CASE03 trimmed run

prevention: Reuse the existing production facade and ProviderJob executor; do not add scheduling, retry, timeout, packaging, or delivery authority.
assurance: Freeze benchmark hashes and snapshot tracked source before and after the live run.
control: Run environment, rule, kernel, focused pytest, py_compile, and live side-branch inspection.
improvement: Rank only the observed CASE01/CASE03 breakpoints and leave the next production change to user choice.

interface_expectations: The existing production split-file leaf executor remains the only ProviderJob execution path.
The debug runner writes only diagnostic artifacts outside generated candidates.
The frozen evaluator remains unchanged and does not authorize public delivery.

experiments: Use one candidate-only live pass to distinguish generation drift, semantic handoff, issue mapping, Provider delta, and acceptance failures.
